mapper.select: select count(*) as totalUsers, coalesce(sum(case when status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as enabledUsers, coalesce(sum(case when status = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as disabledUsers from sys_user where deleted = 0

select count(distinct m.user_id) from chat_message m join sys_user u on u.id = m.user_id and u.deleted = 0 where m.deleted = 0 and m.role = 'USER' and m.create_time >= #{from} and m.create_time < #{to}
select count(*) as totalSessions from chat_session where deleted = 0

select count(*) as totalMessages, coalesce(sum(case when role = 'USER' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as userMessages, coalesce(sum(case when role = 'ASSISTANT' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as assistantMessages, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'COMPLETED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as completedMessages, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failedMessages from chat_message where deleted = 0 and create_time >= #{from} and create_time < #{to}

select count(*) as generationTasks, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as successfulGenerationTasks, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failedGenerationTasks, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'INTERRUPTED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as interruptedGenerationTasks from chat_generation_task where create_time >= #{from} and create_time < #{to}

select count(*) as calls, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as successfulCalls, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failedCalls, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'CANCELLED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as cancelledCalls, coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) as inputTokens, coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) as outputTokens, coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, coalesce(sum(case when usage_source = 'ESTIMATED' then total_tokens else 0 end), 0) as estimatedTokens, coalesce(avg(duration_ms), 0) as averageDurationMs from ai_call_log where start_time >= #{from} and start_time < #{to}

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_date, count(*) as new_users from sys_user where deleted = 0 and create_time >= #{from} and create_time < #{to} group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by stat_date

select date_format(m.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_date, count(distinct m.user_id) as active_users from chat_message m join sys_user u on u.id = m.user_id and u.deleted = 0 where m.deleted = 0 and m.role = 'USER' and m.create_time >= #{from} and m.create_time < #{to} group by date_format(m.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by stat_date

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_date, count(*) as new_sessions from chat_session where deleted = 0 and create_time >= #{from} and create_time < #{to} group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by stat_date

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_date, count(*) as messages, coalesce(sum(case when role = 'USER' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as user_messages, coalesce(sum(case when role = 'ASSISTANT' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as assistant_messages, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'COMPLETED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as completed_messages, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failed_messages from chat_message where deleted = 0 and create_time >= #{from} and create_time < #{to} group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by stat_date

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_date, count(*) as generation_tasks, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as successful_generation_tasks from chat_generation_task where create_time >= #{from} and create_time < #{to} group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by stat_date

select date_format(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_date, count(*) as ai_calls, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as successful_ai_calls, coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) as total_tokens from ai_call_log where start_time >= #{from} and start_time < #{to} group by date_format(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by stat_date
mapper.sql: count(*) as calls, coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) as inputTokens, coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) as outputTokens, coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, max(case when usage_source = 'ESTIMATED' then 1 else 0 end) as estimated
mapper.select: select cast(l.user_id as char) as groupKey, coalesce(u.username, cast(l.user_id as char)) as groupName, count(*) as calls, coalesce(sum(l.input_tokens), 0) as inputTokens, coalesce(sum(l.output_tokens), 0) as outputTokens, coalesce(sum(l.total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, max(case when l.usage_source = 'ESTIMATED' then 1 else 0 end) as estimated from ai_call_log l left join sys_user u on u.id = l.user_id and u.deleted = 0 where l.start_time >= #{from} and l.start_time < #{to} group by l.user_id, u.username order by totalTokens desc, groupKey limit #{offset}, #{size}
